# Dayforce

Dayforce is rolling out AI-powered capabilities across its core HCM platform, including conversational voice and video interviewers (via Ribbon AI acquisition) and integration with Claude for workforce data queries inside Anthropic's ecosystem. For TA teams running Dayforce, the platform is consolidating agentic recruiting and AI-assisted decision-making as native features rather than bolt-ons, with permission-scoped access to candidate and workforce data anchored in Dayforce's existing access controls.

## Timeline

- **23 Oct 2026** — Dayforce has agreed to acquire Toronto-based Ribbon AI, folding conversational voice and video AI interviewers into its agentic recruiting portfolio — continued consolidation of screening tech into core HCM suites. — [Dayforce to acquire Ribbon AI to bolster AI recruitment capabilities](https://betakit.com/dayforce-to-acquire-ribbon-ai-to-bolster-ai-recruitment-capabilities/)

- **28 Oct 2026** — A Dayforce connector will let joint customers query and complete work using trusted Dayforce data inside Claude, applying the same permissions and controls. — [Dayforce in Anthropic's Claude to Help You Finish Work – Where You Work](https://techrseries.com/hrtechnology/dayforce-in-anthropics-claude-to-help-you-finish-work-where-you-work/)

## Open questions

- How will Dayforce integrate Ribbon AI's voice/video capabilities with its core screening and scheduling workflows?
- Will the Claude connector become the primary interface for data access, or stay a secondary channel?
